description: This file defines the InstanceCreationController class within the OrangeHRM installer module. It extends an abstract controller, sets up a Vue component for the installation screen, and manages the current screen state during the installation process.

classes.name: InstanceCreationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the instance creation step in the installer process. It prepares the Vue component for the UI and manages screen state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the Vue component for the instance creation screen and updates the current screen state in the application's state container.
